description: Creates a tag, trigger or variable in a workspace. `body` is the resource JSON: minimally { name, type } plus type-specific parameter entries; tags also take firingTriggerId (array of trigger id strings). Example tag body: { "name": "GA4 event", "type": "gaawe", "parameter": [...], "firingTriggerId": ["12"] }. Returns the created resource with its server-assigned id and fingerprint. Requires the tagmanager.edit.containers scope.

body.description: The resource JSON to create (name, type, parameter, and for tags firingTriggerId).

name: create_entity
title: Create a tag, trigger or variable
